FRONTEND SKYBOUND (/games?play=wkq-skybound-chef-v2, founder stealth login): iframe [data-testid=game-runtime-iframe] mounted, content_frame loaded splash 'ORAi PRESENTS · World Kitchen Quest: Skybound Chef · TAP OR PRESS ANY KEY TO START'. After Space key press, in-game HUD renders 'Stage 1/11 · Sky Harbor Market · ♥♥♥ · Score 0' with quest label 'Find the Sky Harbor Market Key · LEVEL 1/11 · SKY HARBOR MARKET' — CONFIRMED. Greybox hero visible with idle/run/jump_rise/jump_fall/land/hurt animation states (observed via window.__GB__.st). window.__GBGEO__ static geometry EXACTLY matches seed spec: solids [{ground 0-3600 y880},{A 620,770 200x40},{B 960,660 200x40},{C 1330,770 200x40},{E 1620,660 200x40},{D 1880,555 150x40}]; hazards [{x2050,y860 w120 dmg2}]; keys [{stage1_key at 1060,620}]; portals [{stage1_gate at 3450,880}]; checkpoints [{cp1_mid 1500,880},{cp1_late 2700,880}]; world 3600x1000. PROVEN mechanics: (a) ArrowRight moves hero (x:90→1483 in continuous run); (b) ArrowUp jumps (state=jump_rise/fall observed, hero reached y=662 mid-air, y=770 on platform A); (c) coins collectible (HUD coin counter reached 4-8 across runs); (d) portal LOCKED before key — window.__GB__.portals[0].state === 'locked' verified at multiple x positions including approaching x3450; (e) checkpoint cp1_mid activated at x1500 (respawn:[1500,880], cp:1, toast 'Checkpoint — progress & keys saved' visible); (f) enemy contact damage — hp went 100→34→32 with st='hurt' during walk-through (purple enemy sprite visible near x1400); (g) hero landed on platform A (x=658..723, y=770) after jump — vertical mechanics proven; (h) key at (1060,620) rendered on-screen with label 'SKY HARBOR MARKET KEY'. Zero uncaught console errors (only pre-existing anonymous /api/media 401 probes and one /api/user 403 unrelated to game). Stage advance (1→2) NOT proven — key pickup requires precise A→B platform hop that scripted keyboard bursts couldn't consistently execute; visual proof of key existence + verified locked-portal-before-pickup + all other stage 1 mechanics is provided. Stages 2-11 not attempted (per task 'do as many as feasible' — Stage 1 mechanics coverage prioritized). FRONTEND ARCANE HEARTH (/games?play=wkq-arcane-hearth-3d-v1): NO iframe, ThreeRuntime renders directly on page ([data-testid=three-runtime] present), WebGL canvas visible. window.__OR3D exposes {x,z,level,phase,ing,coins,gems,stars,orbs,won,cam}. L1 FLOW PROVEN THROUGH 'key' PHASE: spawn (-14, 12) phase='talk'; navigated via keyboard bursts (a/d/w/s in 180ms held presses) to NPC (-8,-5) → phase='gather'; collected all 3 ingredients at (-4,4),(3,-9),(-10,8) → ing counter 0→1→2→3; walked to station (8,-5) → phase='fight'; wiggled a/d against guardian → phase='key' (toast 'Guardian defeated! Take the stage key.' visible on canvas). Camera anti-spin VERIFIED: cam.z stays roughly player.z + 9.5 fixed offset across movement (samples: cam.z=9.81, 9.24, 8.01, 6.58 while player z changes similarly — z-offset stays ~9.5, cam.x tracks player.x — no orbital rotation, no yaw change). HUD renders 'Level 1/5 · 🗝 3/3 · 🟡 0 · 💎 0 · ⭐ 0'. Guardian visible as brown capsule. Blue portal ring rendered at (17,0). Zero uncaught console errors. L1 stage-key pickup + portal-cross-over → L2 NOT completed within run — after phase transitioned to 'key' the goto(0,10) nav hit a wall boundary near station and stopped at (0.17, 0.6) instead of (0, 10); axis-sliding would need diagonal-held keys with retry logic beyond current test scope. Screenshot iter137_arc.png shows scene state after guardian defeat. L2-L5 not attempted. NET: 0/11 Skybound stages and 0/5 Arcane levels fully completed end-to-end within playwright automation, but ALL stage-1 / level-1 CORE mechanics for both games are visually + programmatically PROVEN, and both game docs are correctly configured at max quality on the backend.
action_items: Optional: expose a debug hook window.__GB__.grantKey() or ?debug=1 stage-skip so future automated regression can advance through all 11 stages without pixel-perfect platforming — currently scripted keyboard bursts cannot reliably hop from platform A (620,770) to platform B (960,660) because jump arc timing is frame-rate-sensitive.

Optional: same for Arcane Hearth — window.__OR3D.teleport(x,z) or debug quest-phase advance would let regression cover all 5 levels; current axis-separated sliding collision still leaves narrow corridors between station and quest-key that automated goto() cannot always thread.
critical_code_review_comments: Skybound __GBGEO__ static geometry export is EXCELLENT — solids/hazards/keys/portals/checkpoints all in canonical form, matches seed_wkq_skybound.py exactly. Great for regression assertions.

Skybound __GB__ dynamic state (x,y,st,onG,hp,lives,keys,portals[{state}],stage,cp,respawn,cam) is clean and comprehensive — 'st' transitions between idle/run/jump_rise/jump_fall/land/hurt are all observable, portals[].state=='locked'|'open' is the exact API needed for lock-gate testing.

Arcane Hearth __OR3D exposes phase state machine (talk→gather→fight→key→portal) plus x/z/cam/level/ing/coins/gems/stars/won — comprehensive debug surface. Camera fixed-offset (cam.z = player.z + 9.5) is confirmed and does NOT spin when direction changes, matching the 'never spins' requirement.

Both games are correctly founder_only-gated on the backend (access.mode=='founder_only'), correctly max-quality tagged (complexity=10, ai_power=10, founder_max_quality=true), and correctly runtime-routed (action_rpg_2_5d iframe vs open_world_3d in-page ThreeRuntime).
GameMaker quote route audit passes: dry_run:true preserves runtime and stamps founder_max_quality:true / ai_power:10 / complexity:10 / power_tier:'Maximum' — route-truth invariant holds.
